verdict.rationale: Aider explicitly supports natural-language debugging via /ask (query codebase without editing), /run and /test to surface errors, automatic linting, and a repo-map for context; community evidence corroborates using it to understand unfamiliar codebases and answer questions faster than grep/search. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark of debugging accuracy specifically, and some community reports note subtle errors/laziness that could affect troubleshooting reliability.
